<!--
This report runs R/01_get_aoi_boundary.R through R/14_postprocess_routing.R
(plus 09b_plot_gridded_maps.R, an extra diagnostic step alongside 09) in
sequence, exactly as each script is normally run standalone, and shows
the outputs a collaborator would actually want to look at: the delineated
watershed, VIC's daily water balance, the per-elevation-band snow
diagnostic, period-of-record gridded maps, and routed streamflow at the
pour point.

Every step below FULLY RERUNS, even when a step's own output already
exists. Rerunning downloads (02, 04, 10) is cheap -- those scripts
already skip files they've already fetched. MetSim (06), VIC (08), and
the routing-inputs build (11) do NOT skip already-built output, so those
three are what make a full re-knit slow; that's a deliberate choice
(this report always reflects a genuinely fresh run of the whole
pipeline), not an oversight.

This file must live at the repo root, alongside config.yml and R/ --
every sourced script uses paths relative to the project root (e.g.
source("R/00_config.R")), so knitting this from anywhere else won't
find them. Knitting from RStudio (the Knit button) already uses the
.Rmd's own location as the working directory, which is what you want.

15_calibrate_routing.R (the velocity/diffusion grid search) is NOT part
of the default sequential run below -- it reruns RVIC's convolution step
once per parameter combination, making it far slower than the rest of
the pipeline combined. It's included as an opt-in section at the end,
controlled by this file's `run_calibration` parameter.
-->

Sourcing `R/00_config.R` once up front so this report's own narrative
text (below) can reference `cfg`. Every step chunk further down sources
it again itself too -- that's how each script is normally run standalone
-- which is redundant but harmless (`00_config.R` only parses
`config.yml` and creates output directories that don't exist yet).

```{r load-config}
source("R/00_config.R")
```

## `r cfg$aoi$name` -- `r format(cfg$run$start_date, "%Y-%m-%d")` to `r format(cfg$run$end_date, "%Y-%m-%d")`

This report reruns the full pipeline for the AOI and run window
currently set in `config.yml` (edit that file, not this one, to point at
a different AOI or period).

---

## Step 1 -- AOI boundary + bounding box

Fetches the AOI boundary polygon (watershed draining to the configured
USGS gauge, or a WBD HUC polygon -- see `config.yml`'s `aoi.mode`),
saves it as GeoJSON, and derives the padded lat/lon bounding box later
steps use to subset the Livneh grid.

```{r step-01}
source("R/01_get_aoi_boundary.R")
```

### Watershed

```{r plot-watershed, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(fs::path(cfg$paths$aoi_dir, "aoi_map.png"))
```

## Step 2 -- download Livneh VIC4 parameter files

Downloads the Livneh CONUS VIC4-classic-driver soil/veg/snow-band
parameter files (one-time; already-downloaded files are skipped).

```{r step-02}
source("R/02_download_vic_params.R")
```

## Step 2b -- subset parameters to the AOI

Subsets the full-CONUS ASCII parameter files down to just this AOI's
bounding box before conversion, so the conversion step (3) doesn't have
to run its snow-band matching over the entire CONUS grid.

```{r step-02b}
source("R/02b_subset_params_to_aoi.R")
```

## Step 3 -- convert parameters to NetCDF

Converts the AOI-subset ASCII parameter files into a single VIC5
image-driver parameter NetCDF, via Tonic.

```{r step-03}
source("R/03_convert_params_to_netcdf.R")
```

## Step 4 -- download Livneh forcing

Downloads the raw Livneh Prec/Tmax/Tmin/Wind forcing months covering the
run window plus MetSim's required spin-up window (already-downloaded
months are skipped).

```{r step-04}
source("R/04_download_forcing.R")
```

## Step 4b -- build forcing NetCDF

Subsets each monthly forcing file to the AOI bbox and concatenates
months into one NetCDF per calendar year, MetSim's expected input
layout.

```{r step-04b}
source("R/04b_build_forcing_netcdf.R")
```

## Step 5 -- build the domain file

Aligns the converted parameter NetCDF onto the forcing grid's exact
coordinates and writes `domain.aoi.nc`, which DOMAIN/PARAMS/FORCING all
have to share for VIC's image driver.

```{r step-05}
source("R/05_build_domain.R")
```

## Step 6 -- run MetSim

Derives the full AIR_TEMP/PREC/PRESSURE/SWDOWN/LWDOWN/VP/WIND forcing set
VIC5's image driver requires from Livneh's raw Tmax/Tmin/Prec/Wind. This
does NOT skip already-built output -- it always reruns MetSim over the
full window.

```{r step-06}
source("R/06_run_metsim.R")
```

## Step 7 -- write global_param.txt

Writes VIC's global parameter file, pointing at MetSim's output and this
run's explicit `OUTFILE`/`OUTVAR` configuration (fluxes/snow/snowband
streams).

```{r step-07}
source("R/07_write_globalparam.R")
```

## Step 8 -- run VIC

Runs the compiled VIC5 image-driver binary. This is normally the slowest
step in the pipeline, and does NOT skip already-built output -- it
always reruns the full simulation over the configured run window.

```{r step-08}
source("R/08_run_vic.R")
```

## Step 9 -- postprocess VIC output

Computes AOI-mean daily water balance (runoff, baseflow, AET, PET, SWE)
and a per-elevation-band SWE breakdown, saving CSVs and plots for both.

```{r step-09}
source("R/09_postprocess_outputs.R")
```

### Daily water balance

```{r plot-daily-summary, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "aoi_daily_summary.png"))
```

### SWE by elevation band

```{r plot-snowband, echo=FALSE}
snowband_png <- fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "aoi_snowband_daily.png")
if (fs::file_exists(snowband_png)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(snowband_png)
} else {
  cat("aoi_snowband_daily.png not found -- band_vars_to_read in ",
      "09_postprocess_outputs.R may be empty, or snowband.<startdate>.nc ",
      "is missing.")
}
```

## Step 9b -- gridded period-of-record maps

For each variable in `09b_plot_gridded_maps.R`'s `vars_to_map` (runoff,
baseflow, AET, PET, and SWE by default), computes the mean over every day
in the run at each active grid cell and plots it as a map with the
watershed boundary overlaid -- the spatial complement to Step 9's
AOI-wide daily time series above (that one collapses space and keeps
time; this one collapses time and keeps space).

```{r step-09b}
source("R/09b_plot_gridded_maps.R")
```

### Period-of-record mean maps

```{r plot-gridded-maps, echo=FALSE}
gridded_pngs <- sort(fs::dir_ls(cfg$paths$output_dir, glob = "*aoi_gridded_*.png"))
if (length(gridded_pngs) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(gridded_pngs)
} else {
  cat("No aoi_gridded_*.png files found -- check vars_to_map in ",
      "09b_plot_gridded_maps.R.")
}
```

## Step 10 -- download NHDPlus HR

Downloads the NHDPlus HR flow-direction/accumulation raster package for
the HUC4 containing this AOI (already-extracted data is skipped).

```{r step-10}
source("R/10_download_nhdplus.R")
```

## Step 11 -- build routing inputs

Derives flow direction from NHDPlus HR's hydro-conditioned DEM and
upscales it onto `domain.aoi.nc`'s exact grid, producing
`routing_inputs.nc`. Does NOT skip already-built output.

```{r step-11}
source("R/11_build_routing_inputs.R")
```

## Step 12 -- RVIC parameter generation

Combines the routing inputs, pour point, and within-cell unit hydrograph
into unit hydrographs routed to the outlet.

```{r step-12}
source("R/12_run_rvic_parameters.R")
```

## Step 13 -- RVIC convolution

Routes VIC's `OUT_RUNOFF`/`OUT_BASEFLOW` through the unit hydrographs
from Step 12 to produce daily routed streamflow at the pour point.

```{r step-13}
source("R/13_run_rvic_convolution.R")
```

## Step 14 -- postprocess routing

Reads RVIC's routed streamflow, writes a CSV, and plots it against
observed USGS discharge at the same gauge (if `config.yml`'s
`routing.observed_gauge_site_no` is set) as a timing/shape sanity check
-- NOT a 1:1 validation, since this VIC run is naturalized (no
irrigation diversions, trans-basin imports, or reservoir operations
modeled).

```{r step-14}
source("R/14_postprocess_routing.R")
```

### Routed streamflow

```{r plot-routed-flow, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "routed_streamflow.png"))
```

---

## Step 15 (optional) -- routing calibration grid search

Not run by default -- `15_calibrate_routing.R` reruns RVIC's convolution
step once per velocity/diffusion combination in the grid, which is far
slower than Steps 1-14 combined. To include it, knit with
`rmarkdown::render("run_full_pipeline.Rmd", params = list(run_calibration = TRUE))`,
or set `run_calibration: TRUE` in this file's YAML header.

```{r step-15, eval=params$run_calibration}
source("R/15_calibrate_routing.R")
```

```{r calibration-outputs, echo=FALSE, eval=params$run_calibration}
results_path <- fs::path(cfg$paths$routing_dir, "calibration_grid_search.csv")
if (fs::file_exists(results_path)) {
  knitr::kable(readr::read_csv(results_path, show_col_types = FALSE),
               caption = "Grid search results (sorted best KGE first)")
}
heatmap_path <- fs::path(cfg$paths$routing_dir, "calibration_grid_search.png")
if (fs::file_exists(heatmap_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(heatmap_path)
}
```

```{r calibration-skipped-note, echo=FALSE, eval=!params$run_calibration, results="asis"}
cat("_Calibration grid search skipped (`run_calibration` is `FALSE`)._")
```

---

## Outputs written this run

* `r fs::path(cfg$paths$aoi_dir, "huc_boundary.geojson")`, `aoi_map.png`
* `r fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "aoi_daily_summary.csv")`, `.png`
* `r fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "aoi_snowband_daily.csv")`, `.png`
* `r fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "aoi_gridded_period_mean.csv")`, plus one `aoi_gridded_<variable>.png` per mapped variable
* `r fs::path(cfg$paths$output_dir, "routed_streamflow.csv")`, `.png`
(plus `observed_streamflow.csv` if an observed-gauge overlay was available)

Simulated streamflow above is **naturalized** -- no irrigation
diversions, trans-basin imports, or reservoir operations are modeled, so
even a near-exact drainage-area match to the observed gauge won't match
1:1. Use the overlay to check timing/shape, not absolute volume.
